body:
Whole-map diagnostics previously drew from Maxima's AI update, duplicated graphics loading, and allocated a full-resolution canvas before applying the PNG size limit. This rebuild keeps diagnostic observation at the simulation boundary and exports owned Scenes on the graphics owner.

- Add `--render-game` with strict signed 64-bit scalar fields, shared game artwork, a scoped software target, and output limits applied before allocation.
- Add explicit `--run-game --diagnostic-fields maxima --diagnostic-interval N --diagnostic-png true|false`. Capture fresh planner worlds without forcing refreshes; retain one bounded batch and drain it while threaded simulation is parked.
- Publish checked field/PNG writes and completion metadata together. Report failures and oversized captures without aborting gameplay. Use per-controller paths for players sharing a team.
- Keep drawing independent of live simulation state, including debug gradients and script areas, and preserve current zoom-detail overlays. Reuse existing periodic save options.

Update the maintained CLI, AI telemetry, rendering, and test guides. Development evidence stays outside maintained documentation. No AI policy, game pacing, save-format, replay, or network-version change is intended; optional PNG capture can slow offline runs.

Final local verification on revision 9b47ae493, rebased onto master 1ba640b52:

- All 519 engine cases passed, including the full slow generator catalogue. The full 617-case unit suite passed on an isolated rerun. The first combined run missed the unchanged 100 ms fertility CPU budget at 102.8 ms; the unit rerun measured 92.1 ms and an additional focused rerun 87.5 ms. The original failure and both passing reruns are retained, and the limit was not relaxed.
- All 27 selected software/portable/OpenGL rendering cases passed, covering exports, restoration after exceptions, repeated resource lifetimes, bars, resized views, high-resolution artwork and wrapped seams. The desktop sidebar fixture explicitly scopes desktop presentation.
- All 21 production diagnostics CLI commands and 50 map CLI commands passed. Captures disabled, fields, PNG and threaded PNG have identical per-tick checksums and decompressed final saves; continuation and output failures preserve execution.
- Build-system contracts: 286 checked, three skipped. Simulation-version consistency and whitespace checks passed.
- Rendering a 512×512-tile map to a 128-pixel PNG used 84,464 KiB peak process RSS.

[Exact-revision evidence and reproduction details](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/codex/pr344-local-validation/artifacts/pr344/final-review-evidence/README.md) include source/binary provenance, selection inventory, original and retry JUnit reports, command records, paired saves/checksum traces, matching fields and PNGs.

The maintainer explicitly authorized merging with passing relevant local tests because hosted CI is currently having issues. Linux GCC 15.2 and SDL 3.4.16 were verified locally; GCC 13, Windows, macOS and WebAssembly were not. No cross-platform execution-equivalence claim is made.
title: Capture Maxima placement fields and render bounded game diagnostics through Scenes
